bias_model: One independent constant vector per body and sensor over the whole record; no drift.
noise_model: Independent per-sample, per-channel zero-mean Gaussian; values are sample standard deviations, not continuous spectral densities.
draw_order: For each body: ba uniform(3), bg uniform(3), acc Gaussian(N,3), gyro Gaussian(N,3). Whole record, not blocks.
scenario_coupling: The SAME drawn noise arrays and bias vectors are reused across corresponding groups: noise_only=clean+noise; bias_only=clean+bias; noise_bias=clean+noise+bias. This permits separating the two effects without changing random realizations.
selection: Fixed seeds before estimator execution; no run/seed selection by reference accuracy.
